method.radar: Sentinel-1 VV water over each whole window (per-scene Otsu thresholds, water in >= half of the looks: tide-averaged)
method.optical: Sentinel-2 median MNDWI > 0 over each window's clear looks
method.position: as Phase 11 (landward edge of the sea-connected water); none where the line lies outside the transect
method.change: radar shift >= 30 m, confirmed by the optical shift (>= 20 m the same way), else unconfirmed; below that stable; lrr = nsm / years between the window middles, no CI (two points)
